text:
Ava: Quick sync — customers keep asking for an integrated console view: dashboards + trace hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics. We need to pick a minimally viable surface for launch and call out vetoes.

Leo: high level: we can ship dashboards + basic trace hook points in v1. Cost breakdown and error analytics are heavier (data model + storage).

Priya: agree. Error analytics requires sampling + grouping rules. If we do it naive it explodes storage/cost. We need SLAs on retention.

Marco: from UX, customers want one-click drilldown from cost line item -> traces -> failing spans. We can fake the UX with deep-links to traces before full analytics landed.

Jen: data constraints: to do per-route cost attribution we need token-level metadata in logs or ingest pipeline changes. ETA ~3 sprints to instrument reliably.

Ava: options on the table: (A) Dashboards + trace links + manual CSV cost export (fast), (B) Dashboards + trace hooks + per-route cost (medium), (C) Full error analytics (slow). Which is viable for a Q2 launch?

Leo: (A) is doable this sprint + next. (B) needs schema change and rollout plan for SDKs -> 3 sprints. (C) is a separate milestone.

Priya: operational risk: (B) increases ingestion QPS. Need to surface cost tradeoffs to customers — maybe default low-sample for cost attribution.

Marco: UX compromise: ship (A) but design the drilldown pattern so (B) and (C) slot in without rework. Mock attached in figma: link -> <https://www.figma.com/file/xyz>.

Ava: launch criteria for (A): 1) dashboards cover top 10 customer queries; 2) trace hook docs + example; 3) CSV cost export present and tested; 4) UX drilldown flows validated with 2 customers.

Jen: acceptance tests for cost export: verify per-customer and per-route aggregates for 90 days. I'll own a sample test harness.

Leo: dev tasks: instrument trace link generation (lightweight), dashboard templates, backend CSV endpoint. I'll add perf guardrails: responses must not add >50ms p99 to request paths.

Priya: SRE asks: retention defaults, sampling config, and an opt-in flag for per-route costing to avoid surprise bills.

Ava: decision: move forward with option (A) as Q2 launch. Parallel work: prototype (B) in incubator.

Marco: I'll prepare the drilldown mocks and two customer flows for validation.

Leo: I'll break down tickets and call out infra risk by EOD.

Jen: will stand up the test harness and run tier-1 validation once Leo has endpoints.

Priya: I'll draft runbook snippets for the new CSV export + sampling knobs.

Ava: Nice. Can everyone add their blockers to the sprint board by tomorrow noon? Also tagging @rollout-bot for a canary plan when we cut the feature flag. :thumbsup:

rollout-bot: Canary plan template created: /canaries/console-observe-cost-v1. Add owners and thresholds.

Ava: Next sync Friday 10am — agenda: acceptance criteria signoff + go/no-go. If any objections before then drop them here.

Leo: one ask — confirm whether we need GDPR PII redaction for trace links before launch.

Jen: short answer: yes for EU customers. We'll need a toggle and redaction pipeline. Adds ~1 sprint if required globally.

Ava: note added. Prioritize EU redaction for the early rollouts.

Priya: final note — let's keep error analytics off the critical path. We can demo a lightweight 'error highlights' card driven by existing logs, but not full anomaly detection.

Ava: summary: ship (A) for Q2, prototype (B) in parallel, defer (C). Action owners: Leo (engineering), Marco (design), Jen (data tests), Priya (runbooks). Thanks — talk Friday. :sparkles:
